model_spec.adaptation: fit on the target organization's records, prior centered at the pretrained coefficients
model_spec.calibration: none: the logistic output is the score
model_spec.class_weights: balanced when both classes are present, else uniform
model_spec.dc_rule: ALLOW iff every applicable concept except reversibility is satisfied (unknown counts as not satisfied)
feature_rules: per applicable concept: satisfied, not_satisfied and unknown indicators, and confidence x (satisfied - not_satisfied)
an inapplicable concept contributes zeros; it is never read as satisfied
no action, domain, family, organization, verdict, reason code, backend result, task outcome or trace result
model_spec.hard_rules: applied before every model; never overridden
model_spec.preprocessing: none: the features are bounded indicators (no standardization)
model_spec.pretraining: fit on the synthetic pretraining partition, prior centered at 0
model_spec.promotion_rule: G-synthetic seeds G-combined only if, on synthetic promotion, it has no more false allows than DC and lets at least one should-run record through; otherwise G-combined starts from a zero prior

selection_sets.G-retail / G-combined (retail): family-grouped out-of-fold scores on retail adaptation (up to 5 folds, seed 0) plus scores on retail promotion
selection_sets.G-target(P) / G-combined(P), P in P1, P2: synthetic promotion records of profile P
selection_sets.held-out profile at k: the k adaptation records themselves (k = 0 keeps the pretrained threshold; G-target escalates everything at k = 0)

model_spec.solver: Newton's method, 50 iterations at most, tolerance 1e-10
model_spec.threshold_rule: on the selection set, the cut with zero false allows that lets through the most should-run records; ties go to the higher cut; none admissible means escalate everything
